verdict.rationale: Flutterwave's API can create a hosted payment page (a payment-link equivalent), and its payment plans give it a price-like object for subscriptions. However, the evidence shows no product or catalog object and no documented single-session flow chaining product, price and link creation. The payment-link claim comes from the marketing site and is not tied to an API endpoint, and the missing OpenAPI spec weakens agent-friendliness. Missing for 10: a product/catalog API object, one-off price objects, an API-documented payment-link creation endpoint, a documented end-to-end agent provisioning flow, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new product, price, and payment link via the API in a single session

citations.quote: Create a hosted payment page and redirect your customer to it to pay.
Payment plans let you set up subscriptions for your customers on Flutterwave.
Receive one-off or recurring payments from anyone, anywhere, via your unique payment link.
